name: Chain-of-Thoughts
description: Decompose a problem into a coherent sequence of intermediate steps leading to a solution.

name: Tree-of-Thoughts
description: Explore alternative reasoning paths and evaluate which is most promising. This implementation samples complete strategy-and-answer candidates and selects one by model vote.

name: Analogical Prompting
description: Generate relevant solved examples to guide the solution of a new problem through analogy.

name: Self-Refine
description: Generate an initial solution, then inspect it for errors and improve it using the same model's feedback.

name: Solo Performance Prompting
description: Simulate collaborating personas with complementary expertise or needs. Use their critiques and suggestions to develop a solution within one model response.

name: Step-Back Prompting
description: First identify high-level concepts and principles behind the problem, then use them to guide the specific solution.

name: SimToM
description: Identify information available from the relevant perspective, then answer using that information. For general tasks, establish relevant known facts and knowledge limits before solving.
